knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Your own facts, pricing and positioning. Topiqu picks the relevant parts automatically whenever it writes an article.
knowledge.addDescription: Add a note, a document or a web page. It is ready to use as soon as it shows as indexed.
knowledge.actionError: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
knowledge.emptyDescription: Add product facts, pricing, case studies or approved comparisons so generated articles get your own details right.
knowledge.failed: Indexing failed. Try again or replace the source.

citation.legend: How should articles use this source?

INTERNAL.label: Background only
INTERNAL.description: AI draws facts from it but never links to it. Use this for internal material.

PUBLIC.label: Citable source
PUBLIC.description: Articles may link to it as a source.

knowledge.deleteDescription: Its text and index are removed permanently. Articles that already used it are not changed.

web.site: Find more pages from this website
web.siteHint: We will show the pages found before adding them. You can add up to {count} at a time.

fields.title: Title
fields.noteHint: Markdown headings help split long notes.
fields.file: Choose a PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD file
fields.fileHint: Up to {size}. Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not supported.
fields.publicUrlHint: Leave empty to keep the source internal.
fields.validAsOfHint: When this content was true. Time-sensitive claims older than 12 months are flagged for review.
fields.validAsOfAddHint: Optional. Filled from the document or page date when available.
fields.sitemapHint: Imports up to {count} pages of the same site that are not in your knowledge yet.

errors.unsupported: This file type or page could not be read.
errors.empty: No readable text was found. Scanned documents need a text layer.
errors.unreachable: The page could not be fetched.
errors.duplicate: This content is already in your knowledge.
errors.quota: Your knowledge base is full. Delete a source to add another.
errors.sitemapEmpty: We could not find any new pages to add from this website.

knowledge.usage: not used yet | used once, last | used {n} times, last
knowledge.refreshFailed: The last automatic refresh failed; the previous version is still in use.
knowledge.passagesHint: This is exactly what the writer can receive from this source, one passage at a time.

playground.title: Try a topic
playground.description: See which knowledge Topiqu would give the writer for an article on this topic. Nothing is generated.
playground.placeholder: e.g. How to speed up content approvals
playground.selected: No source would be used | 1 source would be used | {n} sources would be used
playground.none: No knowledge is relevant to this topic, so the writer would get none.

knowledge.sitemapImported: Imported {added} pages, skipped {skipped}. Indexing has started.

sitemap.cappedByBatch: One import adds at most {count} pages. Run it again for the rest.
sitemap.cappedByQuota: Your knowledge base has room for {count} more sources.

consent.label: I confirm it contains no confidential or personal data
consent.scope: Confidential includes trade secrets and anything else that must not appear in a public article.
consent.title: How AI will use this source
consent.useInternal: AI may use the facts and figures in this source in your published articles, without linking to it.
consent.usePublic: AI may use the facts and figures in this source in your published articles and may link to it as a source.
consent.processing: The content is processed by an external AI provider (OpenAI) when it is added, whenever it changes and when articles are written. We keep only the extracted text, until you delete the source.
consent.confirm: I confirm this source contains no confidential information, trade secrets or personal data that must not appear in a public article.

feed.whereBuiltIn: Most shop platforms: in the admin, under exports for Google Shopping or Heureka.
feed.wherePlugin: WooCommerce, Shopify: through a product feed plugin or app.
feed.languageHint: Used only in articles in this language.
feed.currencyHint: If the feed does not state it.

errors.unreachable: The feed could not be downloaded. Check the link.
errors.tooLarge: The feed is larger than 50 MB.
errors.notFeed: This link is not a Heureka or Google Shopping feed.
errors.empty: The feed has no usable products (missing ID, name or https link).

feed.skipped: No entry skipped | 1 feed entry skipped (missing ID, name or https link) | {n} feed entries skipped (missing ID, name or https link)
feed.truncated: No product over the limit | 1 product left out by your plan limit | {n} products left out by your plan limit
